instruction_summary: Extend the FV living-update (Todd et al., ICLR 2024) to the 2026 model refresh: add Qwen3.5-9B-Base (Mar 2026, MM-arch, hooked via transformers not nnsight) and optionally gemma-4-12B to the era ladder, reusing the 2021-2025 results verbatim, and state whether the FV finding still holds on 2026 models.
recovery_context: SLURM compute finished at walltime; a /net/projects2 read-only storage outage blocked the card write. This is pure CPU post-processing of existing on-disk fu2_summary.json results (no GPU, no model load, no FV/nnsight/transformers re-run). Outputs staged under /net/scratch/haokunliu/fv003-recovery/; copy_back.sh lands them once projects2 is rw.
headline: Zero-shot function vectors are still DETECTABLE but MUCH WEAKER on 2026 MM-arch models (Qwen3.5-9B mean 16.9%, gemma-4 antonym 18.0%, vs Llama-2 92.2% / OLMo-2 89.3% in 2023-25); FV > baseline every completed task (real, small causal effect); peak edit layer stays mid-to-late (~0.52, depth/3 still broken). Methodological caveat: transformers forward-hooks on GQA/MM attention (nnsight cannot wrap), gemma-4 mixed head_dims - part of the attenuation may not be a pure model property.
